title: CloudWatch: metrics, dashboards and custom metrics

videos.script: A graph shows orders falling to zero at three in the morning. Is the shop broken, or is the graph? {{graph}} A metric is three things at once. A namespace, a name, and dimensions. Leave one dimension out of a query and you are asking about a metric nobody published. {{identity}} Then the average. Ninety-five requests take forty milliseconds and five take nine hundred. The average is eighty-four, the latency of no request at all. {{average}} Percentiles tell the truth. p99 says one customer in a hundred waits almost a second. {{percentile}} This lesson publishes the shop's own metrics, and reads them back the way that tells the truth. It counts what one careless dimension does to the bill. And it builds a dashboard for the person who opens it at three. {{lab}} By the end, you can say which statistic answers which question, and why a customer's id never becomes a dimension. {{end}}
